title: The Enchanted Forest
intro:
You awaken in a mysterious enchanted forest. Strange sounds echo through the trees.
Your adventure begins now...

forest_clearing.name: Forest Clearing
forest_clearing.description: You stand in a small clearing surrounded by towering ancient trees. Sunlight filters through the leaves above. A narrow path leads north into deeper woods, while you can hear the sound of running water to the east.

items.name: stick
items.description: A sturdy wooden stick, perfect for walking or defending yourself.
items.use_message: You wave the stick around menacingly. It's not much, but it's better than nothing.

deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
deep_forest.description: The forest grows darker here. Twisted roots snake across the ground, and mysterious glowing mushrooms provide an eerie light. You feel like you're being watched. A cave entrance is visible to the west.

items.name: mushroom
items.description: A glowing blue mushroom. It pulses with an otherworldly light. You've heard these have magical properties.
items.use_message: You eat the mushroom. Your vision swims with colors, and you feel energized! Your wounds heal slightly.

items.name: rope
items.description: A coil of sturdy rope, about 50 feet long. Always useful for an adventurer.

river.name: Riverside
river.description: A crystal-clear river flows swiftly past. The water sparkles in the sunlight. You can see fish swimming below the surface. To the north, an old wooden bridge crosses the river.

items.name: bottle
items.description: An empty glass bottle. You could fill it with water from the river.
items.use_message: You fill the bottle with fresh, cool water and take a drink. Refreshing!

bridge.name: Old Bridge
bridge.description: A rickety wooden bridge spans the river. Some planks are missing, and it creaks ominously. On the far side, you can see a village.

village.name: Village Square
village.description: A small, quiet village. A few cottages surround a central square with a well. The villagers seem to have abandoned this place in a hurry.

items.name: coin
items.description: A silver coin, stamped with the image of a crown. Currency of the realm.

shop.name: Abandoned Shop
shop.description: An old general store, its shelves mostly bare. Dust covers everything, and cobwebs hang from the corners.

items.name: lantern
items.description: An old brass lantern. It still has oil in it and works perfectly.
items.use_message: You light the lantern. Warm light floods the area, pushing back the shadows.

items.name: map
items.description: A hand-drawn map of the region. It shows the forest, river, village, and a mysterious location marked with an 'X'.

cave.name: Dark Cave
cave.description: A damp, dark cave. You can barely see a few feet ahead. Strange sounds echo from deeper within. You'll need a light source to explore safely.

items.name: crystal
items.description: A beautiful glowing crystal, pulsing with inner light. It seems to contain ancient magic.
items.use_message: You hold the crystal aloft. It glows brighter, and you feel its power flowing through you!
